purpose: Document city-scope registry evidence and bounded public parcel-geometry route review.
assessment: A local land-registration custodian is evidenced, but no safe public parcel geometry service or native parcel identity schema was verified. No sample GeoJSON was retained.
registryAssessment: Kantor Pertanahan Kabupaten Nganjuk is a real local registry/cadastre custodian under ATR/BPN, evidenced by official Nganjuk reporting on PTSL certificate delivery and GEMAPULDADIS preparation. This is registry evidence only; it is not evidence of an open bulk parcel layer.

officialPrimarySources.observation: Official local report documents Kantah Nganjuk PTSL certificate delivery in Desa Setren.
Official local report documents Kantah Nganjuk GEMAPULDADIS/ PTSL 2026 preparation and land-field mapping objective.
Official local report describes Sentuh Tanahku Cek Bidang as identifier-driven property lookup, not an anonymous bulk feature service.
Accessible spatial catalog lists non-parcel datasets and no bidang tanah layer.
